carried.equipment: You wear heavy armor and wield a heavy weapon.
You wear heavy armor and wield a heavy weapon.
You wear heavy armor and wield a heavy weapon.

note: "carried" is build-time equipment only: the kit, its equipment text, and the Wealth and Renown values on the derived baseline. A mutable inventory is not implemented — no table in the composed convex/schema.ts holds items — so this records that the baseline equipment is conserved, not that any in-play possession was preserved.
